joins.note: The official access page gives airport bus to Fuao Village stop and an approximate walk to the passenger transport building; it does not establish a timed sailing connection or a stop-ID interchange.

Taitung County's official island-transport page names Taiwan Tourist Shuttle, Xingdong Bus or taxi from Taitung Airport to Fugang before boarding the Green Island or Orchid Island ferry; it does not establish a timed transfer or direct airport-to-pier service.

Taitung County's official page says passengers can continue from the railway station by Taiwan Tourist Shuttle, Xingdong Bus or taxi to Fugang; this is an access chain, not evidence of a direct rail platform, timed transfer or guaranteed sailing connection.
